text:
ciara-support: getting several customer escalations — hosted API returning 502/504 and timeouts when requests hit the prefix cache. Spike started ~09:23 UTC. Customers reporting streaming cut and request failures. example request-id: req_0a12b3c4

maria-sre: looking at prod metrics — cache-tier error rate ~22% on memcached-prefix cluster (pfx-nyc-1). API 5xx spike correlates with memcached connection errors + client timeouts. Gateway shows 502s when cache lookups fail.

lee-runtime: recent memcached client bump to v3.2.1 rolled at 09:10 UTC to all runtime nodes — rolling now. quick log excerpt:
```
ERR memcached: connection refused to 10.2.4.12:11211
WARN cache: prefix get timeout=1200ms key=usr:pref:abcd1234
```

sam-ops: memcached pods observed OOMKilled and flapping on node n5-nyc-4, kernel logs show network interface reset events around 09:15.

ciara-support: top impacted routes reported by customers: /v1/generate, /v1/chat, and embeddings. Customers see retries then final 5xx. raised an immediate escalation ticket.

maria-sre: mitigation plan (short): disable prefix caching for affected routes to force origin fallback and reduce pressure on kv-layer. patch to flip: `cache.prefix.enabled=false` for route group, and set `cache.local_ttl=30s` to soften thundering herd.

oncall-josh: on it — starting rollback of memcached client to v3.1.8, will restart memcached statefulset and temporarily scale replicas +2. also enabling smarter backoff for client (socket timeout 800ms->1600ms).

deploy-bot: rollback started by @oncall-josh — job id 98273 queued.

lee-runtime: pushed a hot-config change to runtime: increased client socket timeout and disabled prefix lookups on canary nodes. snippet: `runtime.cache.client_timeout=1600` and `runtime.cache.prefix_lookup=false` for canary.

maria-sre: Observability note: added an alert rule to fire when `memcached_conn_errors > 5%` across prefix cluster for >2m. Also adding a dashboard row to show prefix hit rate vs origin fallback.

sam-ops: memcached cluster currently shows rejoin/eviction storm. suspect large TTL churn and some keys with unexpectedly large values causing memory pressure. collecting pmap/metrics.

ciara-support: customer comms sent: "We're aware of request failures and have performed temporary fallback to origin while we stabilize our cache tier. We'll follow up with a post-incident timeline." :white_check_mark:

oncall-josh: after rollback + disabling prefix caching for affected routes, 5xx rate dropped from ~18% -> ~2% within 6 minutes. Latency stabilized. continuing to monitor for 30m.

lee-runtime: followups: add canary requirement for memcached client version changes, instrument client to surface per-host connection failures, and add per-key size guardrails.

maria-sre: filing incident ticket and tagging eng-runtime + ops for root cause analysis. temporary runbook entry: if memcached prefix errors >5% for 5m then toggle `cache.prefix.enabled=false` and scale memcached + restart connectors.

ciara-support: looping back to impacted customers with a short summary and ETA for full postmortem.

oncall-josh: marking as resolved for now — will keep channel open for one hour for any regressions.
